name: WooCommerce (+ inline Stripe)
evidence: svgkingdom.com order #35675 and brushespack.com order #681199, both confirmed by merchant email receipts
gotchas: Many small WooCommerce stores use PayPal PPCP (guestEnabled:false) instead of the Stripe gateway — no guest card path; detect via classifyCheckoutSignals and skip.
Stripe iframe detection must match URL pathnames, not full URLs: accessory/express frames can carry 'elements-inner-payment' in query params as a false positive.
A sub-minimum price renders 'No valid payment method types' instead of a card frame — treat as stripe-minimum-or-config, not fillable.

steps.addToCart: Click .single_add_to_cart_button and VERIFY via the .added_to_cart link or /cart/ line items — the AJAX add silently no-ops if fired too early. Fall back to the Store API (/wp-json/wc/store/products) + /?add-to-cart=<id> seed.
steps.billing: Set #billing_country FIRST (it AJAX-refreshes state/postcode rules and totals), then #billing_first_name/_last_name/_email/_phone/_address_1/_city/_postcode and #billing_state. Use the card's billing-address tokens so AVS matches the issuer.
steps.payment: selectCardPaymentMethod() then waitStripeCardFrame(); usually a Stripe Payment Element (iframe titled 'Secure payment input frame'). Fill expiry, then the card-number token, then the CVV token immediately after.
steps.placeOrder: Accept T&C by clicking the LABEL (label[for=terms] — the hidden #terms input no-ops), then click #place_order once.
